## dataset
```{python}
#| message: false
#| warning: false

from palmerpenguins import load_penguins

penguins = load_penguins()
print(penguins.head())
```

## dataset intro
The data called penguins came from the package [Palmer Penguins] (https://allisonhorst.github.io/palmerpenguins/).


## count the number of penguins for each species
```{python}
penguins["species"].value_counts()
```

## find the specie with min body_mass_g

```{python}
print(penguins.sort_values("body_mass_g", ascending=True)[["species", "body_mass_g"]].head(1))
```

## the plot of species v.s. body mass
```{python}
#| label: fig-penguin-mass
#| fig-cap: "body mass of penguins by species"

import altair as alt

plot = (
    alt.Chart(penguins.dropna(subset=["species", "body_mass_g"]))
    .mark_circle() 
    .encode(
        x=alt.X("species:N", title="species"),
        y=alt.Y("body_mass_g:Q", title="body mass (g)")
    )
    .properties(width=300, height=200))

plot
```
